text: Figure 10.23: Modeling of TimeSyncPortPrototypeToTimeBaseMapping The TimeSyncPortPrototypeToTimeBaseMapping takes the Process into account so that every instantiation of an Executable (and the resulting instantiation of all the RPortPrototypes typed by a sub-class of AbstractSynchronizedTimeBaseInterface) can be mapped individually to TimeBaseResources.
